snippet.title: Gravity Snake
snippet.description:
Play: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/755920

Move the snake with ARROWS or WASD or SWIPE or GAMEPAD STICK.

This game is a mix between the classic snake game and a platformer.

The snake grows if you let him eat an apple. Unlike the classic snake game this snake has gravity.

Check my games:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/nannings
http://nannings.nz/
